stories.title: Audit Log Schema and Append-Only Contract
stories.description: Define the canonical audit log schema including timestamp, actor, action_type, payload_hash, outcome, and correlation_id. Enforce append-only behavior at the data model level (no updates/deletes) and align with existing MongoDB logging patterns.

stories.title: Core Append-Only Audit Logging Engine
stories.description: Implement backend logic to capture and persist all system actions and tool calls as immutable audit records. Ensure write-once semantics, hash-based payload integrity, and automatic timestamping for every event.

stories.title: Tool Router and Service Integration
stories.description: Integrate audit logging into tool_router and key domain services to ensure all tool invocations, safety triggers, and external API calls are recorded with consistent audit entries and correlation IDs.

stories.title: Audit Log Access Interface (Internal API)
stories.description: Provide internal query interface for retrieving audit logs by correlation_id, time range, or action_type for debugging and compliance use. Ensure read-only access with no mutation capability.
stories.evidence: GAP: No explicit audit log query interface exists; required for operational visibility

stories.title: Audit Logging Test Suite and Integrity Validation
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests to verify append-only enforcement, correct event capture for tool calls, payload hashing integrity, and absence of update/delete operations on audit records.
